correctness.rationale: Fresh exact rational reconstruction gives zero reaction residuals at the stated positive equilibrium. At \(k=0\), \(a_2,a_1,a_0\) and \(a_2a_1-a_0\) are all positive, so the cubic is Hurwitz. At \(k^2=1/4000\), \(a_2,a_1,a_0>0\) but \(a_2a_1-a_0<0\). For a real monic cubic this violates the necessary-and-sufficient Routh-Hurwitz condition, while positive coefficients exclude a positive real root by Descartes' rule, so the unstable roots are a complex conjugate pair. This proves a finite-mode linear wave instability only; it does not prove a nonlinear traveling wave.
